cases.title: Rocky, Wooded Landscape with a Dell and Weir
cases.description: In a sketchy manner, Gainsborough convincingly singled out the various elements comprising this sweeping landscape—meadow, rocks, trees—by only slightly varying colors and brushstrokes.
